verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers merchant onboarding, pricing templates, payouts, disputes, and webhooks, but nothing describes splitting a single charge across multiple parties, taking a platform cut, or reversing/adjusting such splits as API objects. Tilled's evidence centers on single-merchant payment processing and ISV platform fee/pricing templates, not multi-party charge splitting. Missing for 10: any mention of split payments, multi-party charge routing, application fees, or transfer/reversal objects for splits.
